rule: The wall is the most frequent non-background colour. It forms a vessel with a funnel-shaped opening. The seed is the other colour lying entirely inside the wall bounding box. All remaining colours are obstacles. The flow points away from the side where the seed sits. In the frame where the flow points down: obstacles shadow the background run below them. The seed floods the vessel interior 4-connected, avoiding shadows. Below the vessel, each flooded row's nearest-wall/border boundary continues from its last two runs, at value v0 + (v0 - v1) * ((kk - 1 + t) // m). Cells strictly between the boundaries are filled, except shadows and non-background cells. The grid is then rotated back.
scope: Flood a funnel vessel from the seed, preserve obstacle shadows, and extrapolate the two wall boundary step/period sequences into the outgoing stream in any cardinal direction.
constraints: Four canonical pairs and1000 independent seed checks pass;1000 distinct random inputs.

authored_scope: Random mode: canonical width 9..30 and height 10..30, requested or sampled from the same range, in all four rotations. Cap rows, funnel length and body length scale with the canvas (cap up to H//6, funnel up to f_min+2+H//3, body up to 2+H//3, span extent up to W-4 or W-2). Funnel sides diverge with step 1-2 every 1-3 rows, with independent phases; at least two runs per side are always visible. Placement is free with a margin, or one funnel side touches the border. Extra cap-corner and staircase-corner wall cells appear sometimes. Seed clumps have 1-6 cells. Obstacles: stream cells and bars, distractors above or beside the vessel with shadows, and interior obstacles reusing outside colours. Acceptance requires unambiguous roles and direction, a flooded vessel row everywhere, at least 2 stream rows, and visible widening. Explicit mode reproduces all fixtures with strict record arity. It also accepts vertical or converging boundaries, which follow the literal last-two-run formula; these are labelled as extrapolations. Not supported in random mode: converging or vertical funnels, multiple vessels, deep seeds.
authored_constraints: Background is strictly the most frequent colour, the four corners are background, and the wall is strictly the most frequent non-background colour.
All seed cells lie inside the wall bounding box. No obstacle colour has all of its cells inside that box. Interior obstacles reuse an outside colour.
Flow direction margin: -oy > |ox| + 0.08 in random mode.
Extra walls lie between the cap row and the opening row. They are outside the interior, distinct, and not already part of the derived outline, so the last wall row stays at the opening.
Obstacles are not 8-adjacent to walls, seeds or other obstacles, and are not at corners.
Every vessel row receives flood, and the unshaded interior is 4-connected to the seeds.
The funnel contains at least two complete runs per side (f >= 2m - p + 1), so the run rule is inferable.
Random scenes show at least 2 canonical stream rows of seed colour, and the stream extends beyond the opening's columns in some row.
